A new country, a new language, and one bigger goal after another.

Kevin Trudeau calls Arnold Schwarzenegger one of the greatest success stories of modern times. He came to America, became number one in bodybuilding, then built a name in California real estate.

Then he moved into movies and reached the top. Then he picked a new goal in a completely different field, and Kevin says he reached that one too.

What would your next bigger goal be?
